packets.technical_assessment: Lazy facade вместо очередного relocation — правильный локальный ремонт: contract-only import не должен активировать все stages. Dynamic activation должен возвращать canonical functions, а не copied wrappers. D4 exact deny bytes и первые5 positional полей StageBuildResult — реальные ABI, inputs extension не основание ломать callers.
packets.test_validity: Cold subprocess важнее sys.modules assertion после warmed import. Existing D4 test производит payload и вручную complete manifest: он полезен для parser/CAS seam, но не полный admitted orchestration. Packet правильно требует actual stage→binding consumer; не заменять expected byte literal production formatter.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Второй builder активируется тем же facade механизмом без case-ID ветки. Здесь не нужен второй предметный проект ради lazy import; существенный consumer transfer общий I07-A.
packets.cost_compatibility: PEP562/existing lazy pattern без dependency; измерять cold import dependency closure, не только import elapsed. Поддержать introspection/explicit aliases и failed first import retry.
packets.limits: Qualification-only части не разрешают удалять wrappers по историческому имени.

packets.technical_assessment: Calendar.monthrange и source-owned period parsing соответствуют календарной задаче; не заменять общим fuzzy date parser, способным угадывать missing дату. Inclusive bounds, coarse/fine precision и positional duplicate index semantics важнее pandas index labels.
packets.test_validity: Leap2024/ordinary2023/Q2/year — аналитические independent expected dates; malformed/None и duplicate rows distinct. Missing не measured zero. Historical reevaluation обязана предъявить finite actual inventory, а не произвольный сегодняшней fixture. Хорошо, что пакет не объявляет реконструкцию без periodID.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Новые корректные period strings в уже объявленной grammar проходят без dictionary per date. Transfer irregular fiscal calendar — новая семантика и отдельный owner/profile, не обязанность этого patch.
packets.cost_compatibility: Unique-period precompute сохраняет O(U) parsing+O(N) placement; нет смысла добавлять dateutil ради finite grammar.
packets.limits: Calendar correctness не source authenticity; native Parquet/gate I07-A остаётся обязательным.

packets.technical_assessment: Existing IO/bindings extraction уже есть; повторная архитектурная перестройка не оправдана. Exact legacy JSON bytes, NPZ/Parquet semantic reader и D0–D3 prepared input bindings нужно квалифицировать на реальном producer/consumer.
packets.test_validity: Formatter unit and synthetic payload shape недостаточны. Actual FileSystemCAS+prepare_input_bindings/build consumer должны связать selected refs, а не only expected mapping. Existing mocked atomic writer failure доказывает propagation, не old-file durability: native fail-before-replace если заявляется атомарность.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Добавить второй compatible D0–D3 source manifest с новым schema/data и explicit declared binding, без special country/source branch. Не превращать synthetic input в empirical observation.
packets.cost_compatibility: JSON+NPZ existing writer достаточен; Parquet current writer не следует автоматически объявлять atomic как JSON. No new serialization framework.
packets.limits: Нужно назвать конкретный принимающий consumer/config в execution manifest; whole Scientist/Foundry реализованность из IO roundtrip не следует.

packets.technical_assessment: Disk-captured immutable read + bounded Arrow batch + prefix accounting соответствует replay при mutation/rebatch. Копия на диск дороже прямого parquet scan, но необходима для выбранного неизменного источника; mapper failures не должны провоцировать reader fallback и дублирование accepted prefix.
packets.test_validity: Сильные controls уже предусмотрены: exact row IDs, same-size restoredmtime/ABA, confirmed vs pending counters и actual reader fault. Wrong implementation «dedupe по value» проходит sum/count-only oracle, но ломается distinct IDs with equal values; это следует сохранить.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Transfer меняет batch/rowgroup boundaries и duplicate index layout, а не только seed. Второй compatible table с nullable numeric и variable-width strings испытывает тот же snapshot owner.
packets.cost_compatibility: Arrow22 iter_batches не whole-file pandas; O(file) temporary storage/free-space admission, peak batch memory и prefix reread measurable. DuckDB Arrow handoff — optional future measured optimization, не нынешний prerequisite.
packets.limits: No global exactly-once/no power-loss durability из одного retry. Disk full должен оставить old output и close captured handles.

packets.technical_assessment: Preflight unavailable до server guard разумен: absence checkout — structural capability, не попытка обойти запрещённый action. Workspace root и artifact root отдельны; callbacks принадлежат Ops. Installed C7 receipt требует real same-child collection/setup/call/teardown, не stdout passed.
packets.test_validity: Подходящий positive fixture с actual callback рядом с missing-root denial предотвращает always-unavailable. Installed console/import proof отдельно от rendered shell command. Fake runner допустим для cwd/env composition, но не для receipt lifecycle.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Transfer checkout vs installed/no-checkout forms имеет смысл; не требовать реального provisioning всех окружений для diagnostic fix.
packets.cost_compatibility: Existing pathlib/packaging composition enough. Не вычислять repo через parents[N], не добавлять runtime registry.
packets.limits: Actual deployment requires отдельное разрешение и target evidence. Review ничего не запускает.

packets.technical_assessment: Role-aware assembler выбран правильно: scalar/aggregate согласованность, equal legacy duplicate vs conflicting value, metadata preservation и reserved evidence last. Но exact index validator поставлен после before np.asarray — FA-01. Исправление должно захватить raw scalar identity.
packets.test_validity: Mixed big int/integral float discriminator обязателен. Existing TEST02 homogeneous extrema недостаточны; full public DTO+historical+candidate covers error translation. Candidate helper патчит unrelated gates — его нельзя выдавать за admitted full orchestration; пакет честно отмечает это.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Два state axes разного размера и materialized entrants/donor дают reusable pure aging. Изменить не только labels: разные positive flow/zero entrant structure и optional donor disposition.
packets.cost_compatibility: Никакой новой unit/index library. O(N) source admission+canonical int64. Signed record IDs сохраняются; state IDs range ограничен.
packets.limits: Inventory receipt доказывает captured inputs, не научную пригодность. Прогноз/калибровка на synthetic fixture остаются conditional.

packets.technical_assessment: Numeric contract сильный: finite extremes/subnormal/cancellation, MEDIAN validation до singleton, distinction arithmetic point vs actual source selection. Предпочтительнее existing statistics.mean за common wrapper, чем новая arithmetic implementation (FA-04). Custom exact algorithm сам по себе не ошибочен.
packets.test_validity: Expected exact rational result независим; вычисление expected тем же helper запрещено. Три sources/second JOIN/persisted fresh reader проверяют cell lineage, repeated keys, null/cardinality. Wrong shared producer attribution проходит numeric-only asserts, но не cell-origin matrix.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Поменять primary priority, secondary overlap и missingness, не только values; holdout с source names вне fixtures и одними контрактами. Candidate composition не зависит от эмпирической source independence.
packets.cost_compatibility: Common stdlib3.14 wrapper, group cost измерить; mean streamable, median требует central selection. Bounded audit не означает full composition O(1) memory.
packets.limits: Scalar MEDIAN выбирает действительный admitted cell, не synthetic median source. Не менять tolerance/tie policy под numeric test.

packets.technical_assessment: Schema-first typed empty UNION и one bounded audit collector решают реальные дефекты без новой relational engine. Declared nullable schema-only column должна создаваться до pd.concat templates; no-sources отличается от lawful empty sources.
packets.test_validity: Full typed schema through SQL fresh reader + summary/full/none equal results и full conflict counts сильнее len0/count-only. Heap tiebreaker stable sequence не должен сравнивать MergeLog payload. Transient allocation census полезен, но не RSS/latency proof.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Transfer repeated keys+secondaries with different priority and unused source; index once per used secondary. Новый declared field без rows — решающий schema transfer.
packets.cost_compatibility: Сохранить pandas2.3 current ABI; DuckDB rewrite только по measured need. Per-composition lazy indexes не global mutable cache.
packets.limits: Schema authority не утверждается inferred pandas dtype; no-source refusal не считается lawful empty positive.

packets.technical_assessment: Normalize paired source axis до inferred linspace и equal-length shortcut — правильное место; np.interp сам не валидирует domain invariants. Unit/interval compatibility всей selected series, не unit первого record. Не навязывать Pint/global conversion: upstream declared conversion owner достаточен.
packets.test_validity: Local _resample explicit target test уже может быть green при broken prepare_targets inferred branch: будущая suite правильно должна пройти public prepare_targets equal-length/inferred и compiler→optimizer. Oracle line y=2t+1 аналитичен; masks/IDs отдельны. Empty support/zero/fill различаются.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Transfer нерегулярная сетка, перестановка+переименование IDs, explicit reversed requested grid, другой unit объявленный upstream conversion. Не требовать generic model invention.
packets.cost_compatibility: Stable O(nlogn) sort и existing NumPy/JAX. Measurement compiler explicitlyfloat32, native profile tolerance/report должны быть dtype-aware; не утверждать binary64 precision всего model path.
packets.limits: Передача CAL-02 в I10-A нужна для optimizer/report sensitivity; target correctness не empirical model validity.

packets.technical_assessment: Catalog visibility не должна проходить executable connector projection. Исправить predicate через current selection owner, сохранив governed source config semantics; не отождествлять catalog-only с callable source.
packets.test_validity: Explicit default vs [] vs None, seed closure и same-stat policy bytes контролируют реальные meanings. Wrong predicate alwaysTrue проходит один legal source, но должен сломаться excluded private/catalog-only/control source.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Второй catalog-only entry с иной source family добавляется data/profile без connector stub. Policy denied executable всё ещё denied; free-grow не значит обход access.
packets.cost_compatibility: Existing typed YAML registry достаточен; no second parser/list. Lazy YAML import и compatibility exports сохранить.
packets.limits: Catalog listing показывает discoverable, не executable/authority.

packets.technical_assessment: Existing finite binding/context extraction уже выполнен, поэтому retain owners и квалифицировать actual three leaf groups. ContextVar правильнее module global overrides; scope restoration в finally нужно проверять при exceptions/cancellation.
packets.test_validity: AST/import architecture tests не проверяют SQL write/manifests. Actual canonical caller с native DB и two concurrent bindings обязан выдавать раздельные outputs; second invocation after exception проверяет reset, а не только successful path.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Compatible source через finite existing bindings без добавления нового global alias. New unsupported semantics legitimate code extension, не бесконечный injection registry.
packets.cost_compatibility: MappingProxyType shallow — caller-owned mutable values надо использовать по объявленной lifecycle, не считать deep immutability. Не вводить heavyweight DI framework.
packets.limits: Нет нового root-cause fix без найденного mismatch; full LA038 closure включает callers and actual manifests.

packets.technical_assessment: Потерянный empty_shards counter протянуть через actual aggregate. Facade stale delegate решается small weak identity bookkeeping либо stable forwarding with current owner lookup; не broad monkeypatch broadcast и не дублирование API функций.
packets.test_validity: Counter test должен получить actual complete-empty shard а не fake returned dictionary; existing unit mocks useful wiring only. Два сохранённых wrapper handles до и после owner change различают stale closure, один latest wrapper — нет.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Transfer explicit binding, default binding и concurrent scope with cancellation. Не поддерживать произвольное reflective private symbol patching ради теста.
packets.cost_compatibility: Weak refs избегают unbounded retained wrapper list; stable dynamic lookup дешевле, но preserve exact dispatch/exception identity.
packets.limits: empty_shards — metric, не completeness evidence без selected denominator. Canonical writers unchanged.

packets.technical_assessment: Strict nonnegative integer counts (not bool/coercion) и content-bound resume правильны. §5 содержит неподдержанный sync helper; off-only alternative не покрывает smart direct admission. FA-02: existing async finite-stage route предпочтителен.
packets.test_validity: Endpoint/profile mutation при прежнем source.name и coherent old payload must force acquisition. Only config.resume assertion не проверяет stage work; TEST02 требует counted connector+fresh receipt. [] required outputs vs None — реальный all([]) adversary.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Два источника с complete_empty/nonempty; same bytes/newmtime reuse, same stat/newbytes miss. Transfer через новые source metadata, не fixture filename.
packets.cost_compatibility: Whole selected hashing costly but preserves threat model; measure separately, immutable lease only if proved. Core/QC remain live noncacheable.
packets.limits: Off не означает запрет независимого lawful transport cache. Native build not run.

packets.technical_assessment: Existing shared encode kernel хороший reuse: разные Academic/Catalog text projections остаются domain-owned, matrix/index normalization и dtype общие. Re-extract no need. Dimension from actual encoder4 vs fallback99 полезно отличает silent pad.
packets.test_validity: Настоящие DuckDB/NumPy/HNSW нужны вместо JSON recorder; deterministic encoder допустим только wiring. Пакет честно не доказывает model quality/ANN recall. Дополнительный topology query oracle делает search wiring более различающим, но scientific quality отдельно.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Text preparation profiles и ID collision controls существеннее другого seed. Добавить compatible corpus без domain routing в kernel; retain separate SQL truncations.
packets.cost_compatibility: M16/ef_construction200 preserved; set_ef100 after load exists. vector-search native build3.14 отдельно; не ставить latest library ради ремонта.
packets.limits: Current selected ordering сознательно canonical, legacy byte order иной. Unbound encoder может produce candidate, не reuse authority.

packets.technical_assessment: Перед selector switch вызвать существующую semantic admission — оптимальный небольшой fix. Hashes не видят coherent but wrong index vectors; common staged validator нужен, selected flag forge не нужен. Postcommit projection error не rollback уже committed selector.
packets.test_validity: Coherent inventory wrong vector до commit — сильный counterexample, лучше простой tamper checksum. Fresh reader after each failure phase и valid replacement исключают always-reject. Both warm/fresh effective-text mutation and beyond-truncation positive keep exact model-input semantics.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Перестановка IDs/добавление/withdrawal и второй domain reader показывают shared publisher. Не общий третий generation framework.
packets.cost_compatibility: Warm revalidation cost FA-05; не ослаблять currentness ради speed. HNSW stored normalized cosine vectors correspondence requires tolerance, not arbitrary byte identity.
packets.limits: No fsync/powerloss claim from os.replace; readiness/QC distinct from valid index.

packets.technical_assessment: Legal incremental per-record text/assets/tokenizer identity следует сохранить, а не менять на Academic full rebuild или ID-only cache. Owned runtime positive served query действительно добавляет способность; source-owned finite CPU1024/ST2.7 profile допустим старт, не вечный hardcoded universe.
packets.test_validity: Three tables, append/change/withdrawal/revision invalidators и actual owned model без mocked gate сильны. Но «полезный» результат требует relevance target/holdout, FA-06. Runtime owner trusted-process assumption не доказывает защиту от hostile concurrent mutation всех globals.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Второй corpus с иными legal entities/facts/provisions и paraphrase query через тот же профиль. Новый model backend — новая semantic/runtime qualification, не обязан автоматически пройти.
packets.cost_compatibility: Optional rag-local и provided assets обязательны; tiny corpus still full model load/RSS. Long text truncation query adversary может выявить false abstention. No downloads in review.
packets.limits: Candidate similarity не verified source relation; text fallback остаётся полезным, но не заменяет требуемый owned-vector positive.

packets.technical_assessment: Finite pre-admitted request_hash→unique namespace map устраняет first namespace selection без filesystem guessing. Identical HTTP request across two sources действительно неоднозначен без request-scoped identity; bounded upfront unsupported честнее случайного routing.
packets.test_validity: Два real namespaces, unknown request, ambiguity до ingestion и no live fallback обязательны. Различать successful fetch count и actual persisted transform/PII/graph consumer. Replaying recorded bytes не доказывает fresh provider computation.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Второй source namespace с иной request method/body/schema; compatible manifests data-only. Для одинаковых requests нужен новый typed source boundary, не ad-hoc URL suffix.
packets.cost_compatibility: Map O(fixtures), no network service/new router. Content canonicalization owner existing; payload historical bytes не переписывать под old ID.
packets.limits: Finite approved adapter scope only; no arbitrary production access or global exactly-once.

packets.technical_assessment: Initial failure checkpoint должен иметь admitted source/clock/schema identities и empty operator state, а не mutated observed progress. Малый helper identity fields корректнее клонирования live accumulator. Actual committed frontier остаётся единственным resume basis.
packets.test_validity: Independent raw byte/window oracle и actual CAS writes хороши; BaseException injection не OS process death, поэтому separate worker-kill required только для declared crash recovery. First-before-commit failure плюс actual fresh reader решает конкретный gap, not only state DTO.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Count/tumbling/sliding/session и uneven rebatching должны сохранять window memberships/contributor refs; new dataset/source identity через contracts. Withdrawal affected contributor invalidates dependent window, independent retained.
packets.cost_compatibility: Checkpoint snapshot O(retained state) memory+IO, horizon bounds declared. No parallel journal/recovery service.
packets.limits: Source witness identity не сама causal authority; timed event clocks require same admitted semantic profile.

packets.technical_assessment: Owned per-occurrence serialized byte accounting правильно заменяет repeated full sum; id(dict)-only memoization неверна при reuse/mutation. CATEGORY allowed_values is not None отличает empty allowed set от unconstrained; existing quarantine owner достаточен.
packets.test_validity: Exact cap+one byte, repeated identical object occurrences, mutate-after-admit, preview abort, restored state counter independently recomputed. Wrong one-size-per-unique-ID cache проходит unique-row fixtures; explicit repeated reference distinguishes. Window-closing transition must remain admitted without arbitrary forced flush.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Разные window types/variable-width Unicode fields, category[]=denyall vs None=any, UTC expiry after restart. Новая data value не новый branch.
packets.cost_compatibility: O(1) buffered_bytes не full loop O(N): _prune_row_refs scans buffer, preview copies containers. Не предлагать eviction cache для semantic live rows; no unimplemented spill success.
packets.limits: Operator serialized budget не process RSS. Counter/index metadata overhead отдельно measured; capacity refusal preserves frontier.

packets.technical_assessment: Terminal cleanup task cancelled нельзя shield-await forever: inspect done/cancelled and unified settlement retaining owner/permit until real close. Caller cancellation after success сначала settles physical result, then propagates. Design uses existing lifecycle, not new cancellation framework.
packets.test_validity: Watchdog timeout сам по себе не PASS: heartbeat progress, fd remains readable while pending, os.fstat closed after retry, new session acquisition then works. Fixtures must pass legitimate dedupe/source admission before reaching cleanup; removing gate ради finalizer недопустимо.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Two cancellation origins (caller vs owned task), same-session-key replacement and independent pending owners transfer mechanism, no source-specific cleanup branch.
packets.cost_compatibility: Python asyncio primitives adequate. Lock protects metadata, never physical disconnect await. No finite timeout can pretend actual FD close.
packets.limits: Primary provider/sanitizer error identity preserved; cleanup degradation separate, pending ownership explicit.

packets.technical_assessment: Successful result feeds AdaptiveRateLimiter once after actual provider completion. Plain RateLimiter protocol не расширять обязательным callback. Success feedback exception нельзя перехватить как provider RateLimitError и повторить physical call.
packets.test_validity: Actual wrapper+controlled clock matrix: 429 cooldown→success recovery, exception/cancel no success, fractional0.2/s and declared burst, stale circuit generation ignored. Mere call count misses recovered state; next admitted request time distinguishes.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Different connector IDs/tenants sharing intended owner vs isolated profile; registry eviction with pinned leases and late completion. No distributed quota claim.
packets.cost_compatibility: Existing limiter+registry sufficient; tenacity retry cannot replace feedback/generation semantics. Relative sleep sums не absolute deadline.
packets.limits: Provider result/accounting remains primary; adaptive policy unchanged except missing successful feedback.

packets.technical_assessment: Current cached admission и per-attempt deadline — нужный ремонт, но offline ordering явно исправить FA-03. Общий raw transport сохраняет numeric destination/peer/hostname SNI; rewrite HTTP stack без причины не оправдан.
packets.test_validity: Positive legal cached reuse+prohibited final/redirect/MIME/size рядом. Offline DNS-failure control missing in text; add. Deadline injected clock first ends t2 budget1 excludes second; positive failover within budget excludes always-stop. Async cancellation physical worker distinct.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Second compatible profile with different MIME/domain/limits and third-party legacy list provider — не просто another URL. Unknown legacy cache fact explicitly gap/allowed refresh.
packets.cost_compatibility: HTTPX phase timeouts no wall guarantee; outer monotonic async deadline plus existing retained worker owner. No live network in review.
packets.limits: Candidate schema1.1 remains decision, not implied migration; snippet availability not source permission.

packets.technical_assessment: Carry existing typed raw ArtifactRef through manual bytes normalization activates existing acquire recheck; второй CAS/SourceSpec type не нужен. Fetch profile must come from actual applied transport arguments on cache and no-cache routes, not populated test DTO.
packets.test_validity: Native API→CAS→docs/fragments/claims→fresh reader решительно лучше sentinel before publication. v1 then URLv2 without refetch and explicit refresh lineage distinguish cache from accidental fresh retrieval. Corrupt/missing blob must not reconstruct from snippets.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Два документа с повторяющимися фразами и Unicode normalization + multiple snippets; второй applied profile no code branch. Span coordinate system должен быть extracted text, не naive raw-byte offset.
packets.cost_compatibility: Store full raw bytes once; exact profile metadata inexpensive. Native parser/backend qualification separate for HTML/PDF, не promise arbitrary MIME.
packets.limits: Fragment substring proves extraction fidelity, not truth/entailment/copyright rights. Source-bound non-URL manual bytes remain functional.

packets.technical_assessment: Optional metrics/traces не могут скрыть response/mandatory post_record. Нужен safe optional context boundary preserving body exception, не blanket suppress. Existing ledger/accounting owner retain; no new money subsystem.
packets.test_validity: Current native-style composition real FileBudgetLedger/local gateway useful, но _Tracer double не no-OTel fallback proof. Fault matrix enter/exit/attributes/status and mandatory audit failure must verify response/cause+next-spend gate, not only ledger already charged.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Async generate и sync invoke separate routes; normal/fallback tracer profile; missing usage unknown→reconciliation→positive next call. Другой controlled provider reply tests no constant fallback.
packets.cost_compatibility: OTel principle supports optional isolation, но core default includes SDK. Deliberately reduced fallback environment explicit. No external bill/invoice claim.
packets.limits: Unknown cost не zero; consumer reuse events не physical invoice. Body cancellation и mandatory error должны распространяться.

packets.technical_assessment: Finite six-role translator closure — обоснованное новое общее contract extension; не regex whitelist и не universal NL semantics. Exact prepared request binding + current owner/epoch per hit and once bounded revision re-admission avoids needless physical duplicate. Existing coordinator sufficient.
packets.test_validity: One role at a time drift/absence/request/scope must force miss; unchanged literal URL/uncertainty content still hit. Provider fixture should parse actual serialized six-role payload and return role-sensitive valid brief, not constant answer; otherwise consumer wiring can ignore changed material. Cross-loop shared concurrent Future already meaningful.
packets.free_grow_transfer: Два materially different bundles (например fiscal transfer vs service provision) через same translator profile, no dossierID routing. New seventh live role remains unsupported until explicit contract extension; это честная граница, не free-grow дефект.
packets.cost_compatibility: One retry only; no locks around async provider/IO. Capture immutable payload bytes before dispatch; bind selectedCAS facts by current owner. No new distributed cache service. DefaultT0.1 stays; explicitT0/fallbackFalse qualifies reusable route.
packets.limits: T0/cache reuse не гарантирует cloud-model mathematical determinism или policy quality. Tool-calling NL request builder не покрыт. LLM-01 shared files sequential writer.
